question: Estimate the annual food delivery market size (GMV) in Mumbai.
idealClarificationQuestions: GMV (gross order value) or net revenue? Assume GMV.
Only online aggregators (Swiggy/Zomato/Magicpin) or include direct restaurant phone orders? Aggregators only.
Greater Mumbai metropolitan region or just BMC area? Greater Mumbai (~22M).
Include corporate catering / B2B office meals? Exclude — only consumer.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: Mumbai population → food delivery users → segment users by frequency → monthly orders → AOV → annual GMV.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Food delivery app users (ordered at least once in past 3 months): ~35% of smartphone adults = ~5M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai AOV: ~₹450 (higher than national average of ₹350-380 due to premium customer base, higher restaurant prices).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Food delivery app users (ordered at least once in past 3 months)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹450 (higher than national average of ₹350-380 due to premium customer base, higher restaurant prices).

calculationFlow: Smartphone + internet enabled adults: ~14M (Mumbai has ~85% smartphone penetration among adults).
Food delivery app users (ordered at least once in past 3 months): ~35% of smartphone adults = ~5M.
Segmentation: Heavy users (4+/week) 15% = 750K @ ~16 orders/month; Medium (1-2/week) 35% = 1.75M @ ~6/month; Light (1-2/month) 50% = 2.5M @ ~1.5/month.
Mumbai AOV: ~₹450 (higher than national average of ₹350-380 due to premium customer base, higher restaurant prices).
